name: Obsidian Vault MCP Bridge
description: Direct bi-directional Model Context Protocol bridge into local Obsidian vault files & dynamic folder discovery.

tools.name: obsidian_get_vault_info
tools.description: Get status, name, and connection state of the paired Obsidian vault

tools.name: obsidian_list_folders
tools.description: List all subfolders in the Obsidian vault or inside a specific relative path

tools.name: obsidian_find_folder
tools.description: Search for existing folders in the vault matching a keyword or phrase

tools.name: obsidian_create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder or nested directory path in the Obsidian vault

tools.name: obsidian_list_files
tools.description: List files in a specific vault folder with optional extension filter

tools.name: obsidian_search_files
tools.description: Search notes across the vault by title or full text markdown content

tools.name: obsidian_read_note
tools.description: Read the complete Markdown content of a specific note in the vault

tools.name: obsidian_create_note
tools.description: Create a new Markdown note with YAML frontmatter in the vault

tools.name: obsidian_update_note
tools.description: Append or replace content in an existing Markdown note in the vault

tools.name: obsidian_create_daily_note
tools.description: Append or create an entry in today's daily scratchpad note

tools.name: obsidian_delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a Markdown note from the Obsidian vault

tools.name: obsidian_move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a note from sourcePath to targetPath in the vault

tools.name: obsidian_search_backlinks
tools.description: Extract bi-directional link graphs and wikilink references [[targetNote]] across vault

name: Notion Workspace MCP Server
description: Official Model Context Protocol server exposing Notion databases, task management, and knowledge base pages.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search pages and database titles across Notion workspace

tools.name: notion_get_tasks
tools.description: Query active tasks, status Kanban boards, and deadlines from Notion Task Database

tools.name: notion_read_page
tools.description: Read blocks, markdown content, and page properties from Notion

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create new child pages and structured document entries in Notion

tools.name: notion_update_database
tools.description: Insert records and update schema rows in Notion databases

tools.name: notion_query_database
tools.description: Filter and sort structured records inside Notion databases

name: Google Calendar MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server for Google Calendar events, scheduling, attendees, and availability.

tools.name: google_calendar_list_calendars
tools.description: List all Google Calendars in the authenticated user account

tools.name: google_calendar_list_events
tools.description: List and search events in Google Calendar with date filtering

tools.name: google_calendar_get_event
tools.description: Get detailed information for a specific Google Calendar event

tools.name: google_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a new meeting or event in Google Calendar

tools.name: google_calendar_update_event
tools.description: Update an existing event in Google Calendar

tools.name: google_calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event from Google Calendar

tools.name: google_calendar_check_availability
tools.description: Check free/busy availability and open time slots across calendars

name: Android Bridge & Digital Wellbeing MCP
description: Model Context Protocol bridge for Android device telemetry, Digital Wellbeing analytics, app limits, blocking, and DND controls.

tools.name: android_get_device_status
tools.description: Check whether the Android MCP Bridge server is active, accessible, and running on the connected mobile device

tools.name: android_get_usage
tools.description: Retrieve raw application usage metrics and foreground screen time durations recorded since 00:00 today

tools.name: android_get_usage_summary
tools.description: Fetch structured daily Digital Wellbeing telemetry including total screen time, breakdown of top used apps, and most distracting applications for AI analysis

tools.name: android_get_foreground_app
tools.description: Detect the package name of the application currently active on the device screen in real time

tools.name: android_set_app_limit
tools.description: Set a maximum daily usage time limit in minutes for a specific application package

tools.name: android_block_app
tools.description: Instantly block or unblock an application on the Android device

tools.name: android_get_active_restrictions
tools.description: Retrieve all configured daily time limits and the active list of currently blocked applications on the device

tools.name: android_set_dnd
tools.description: Toggle Do Not Disturb (DND) mode on the Android device to suppress notification alerts during focused work sessions

tools.name: android_send_notification
tools.description: Send a local push notification / alert banner to the Android device status bar
